Question 1
?

Consider the set A, defined as

A={1n+4:n∈N}.

Which of the following sets is equivalent to A?

a
{15,16,17,18,…}
b
{15,16,14,13,…}
c
{15,16,18,19,…}
d
{15,16,17,18}
e
{15,16,112,115,…}
